name: At My Command
source:
Ever since Colin, a lowborn yet talented musician, joined the royal court, Prince Maurice hasn't been himself. He would give anything to get closer to Colin, but the boy is so afraid of the royals, he becomes paralyzed in their presence.

If only he knew the mysterious admirer he's been talking to was Prince Maurice himself...

[From [url=https://doksa.itch.io/at-my-command]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自从出身卑微却才华横溢的乐师科林入驻王室宫廷以来，莫里斯王子便一直魂不守舍。为了拉近与科林的距离，他愿付出任何代价；偏偏这名少年对王室成员畏惧到了极点，只要站在王族面前便会浑身僵硬、动弹不得。

倘若他知道平日里一直与自己倾心交谈的那位神秘仰慕者，正是莫里斯王子本人就好了……

[摘自[url=https://doksa.itch.io/at-my-command]itch.io[/url]]
